title: Replace debug func printnbyte with ws_log_buffer
description:
The dcerpc-netlogon and ntlmssp dissectors both had a custom debug
function to dump some memory into hex, called `printnbyte()`. Remove the
custom function and replace calls of it with calls to `ws_log_buffer()`.

Add a message parameter to the `ws_log_buffer()` macro, exposing the
underlying `msg` parameter that gets passed to `ws_log_buffer_full()`.

In `ws_log_buffer_full()`, change `bytes_to_str_maxlen()` to
`bytes_to_str_punct_maxlen()` to make the hex string output a bit easier
to read.

Ping #19519

changes_data.diff:
@@ -419,12 +419,12 @@ void ws_log_buffer_full(const char *domain, enum ws_log_level level,
                     size_t max_bytes_len, const char *msg);
 
 
-#define ws_log_buffer(buf, size) \
+#define ws_log_buffer(buf, size, msg) \
         do {                                                        \
             if (_LOG_DEBUG_ENABLED) {                               \
                 ws_log_buffer_full(_LOG_DOMAIN, LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG,    \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__,               \
-                        buf, size, 36, #buf);                       \
+                        buf, size, 36, msg ? msg : #buf);           \
             }                                                       \
         } while (0)

commits_data.message:
Replace debug func printnbyte with ws_log_buffer

The dcerpc-netlogon and ntlmssp dissectors both had a custom debug
function to dump some memory into hex, called `printnbyte()`. Remove the
custom function and replace calls of it with calls to `ws_log_buffer()`.

Add a message parameter to the `ws_log_buffer()` macro, exposing the
underlying `msg` parameter that gets passed to `ws_log_buffer_full()`.

In `ws_log_buffer_full()`, change `bytes_to_str_maxlen()` to
`bytes_to_str_punct_maxlen()` to make the hex string output a bit easier
to read.
